title: 统计表达 · 效应、不确定性与证据
description: 原创练习，按实际项目使用。20 句练习解释效应量、区间、统计检验、缺失数据、混杂与因果措辞。

source.title: 科研小盒原创科研英语课程 · 2026-10

sentences.en: An effect estimate describes the magnitude of a measured difference.
sentences.zh: 效应估计用于描述所测差异的大小。
sentences.note: the magnitude of 表示某种差异或效应的大小；estimate 强调它是估计值。
sentences.question: Which effect estimate best answers your research question?

sentences.en: Uncertainty intervals help readers judge the precision of an estimate.
sentences.zh: 不确定性区间有助于读者判断估计的精确程度。
sentences.note: help readers judge 表达工具的用途；precision 关注估计的不确定程度，与 accuracy 含义不同。
sentences.question: How would you explain a wide uncertainty interval?

sentences.en: A small p value does not measure practical importance.
sentences.zh: 较小的 p 值并不能衡量实际重要性。
sentences.note: does not measure 用明确的否定动词说明指标的含义；practical importance 需要结合效应及应用背景判断。
sentences.question: What else would you report alongside a p value?

sentences.en: A nonsignificant result does not establish that the effect is absent.
sentences.zh: 统计学不显著的结果并不能证明效应不存在。
sentences.note: does not establish 后接 that 从句；absent 表示不存在，语气强于尚未检出。
sentences.question: How would you discuss an inconclusive statistical result?

sentences.en: Multiple comparisons increase the chance of at least one false positive.
sentences.zh: 多重比较会增加至少出现一个假阳性的概率。
sentences.note: the chance of 后接名词短语；at least one 清楚界定这里讨论的是至少一次错误。
sentences.question: Why should readers know how many comparisons were performed?

chunks.en: of at least one false positive
chunks.zh: 至少出现一个假阳性的

sentences.en: The correction method should match the intended family of tests.
sentences.zh: 校正方法应与预先界定的检验家族相匹配。
sentences.note: match 表示匹配；family of tests 指一组需要共同考虑多重性的问题。
sentences.question: How would you define the family of tests?

sentences.en: Correlation alone cannot establish a causal relationship between variables.
sentences.zh: 仅凭相关性无法确立变量之间的因果关系。
sentences.note: alone 强调证据仅限于相关性；cannot establish 表示该证据不足以确立因果。
sentences.question: What additional evidence would strengthen a causal explanation?

sentences.en: Confounding can produce an association without a direct causal effect.
sentences.zh: 混杂可以在没有直接因果效应时产生关联。
sentences.note: without 后接名词短语，明确一种关联可能出现的条件；can 表示可能机制。
sentences.question: Can you describe a plausible confounder in your study?

chunks.zh: 在没有直接因果效应时

sentences.en: Adjustment reduces some biases only when its assumptions are appropriate.
sentences.zh: 调整只有在相关假设恰当时，才能减少某些偏倚。
sentences.note: only when 给出必要条件；some biases 明确调整不必然消除所有偏倚。
sentences.question: Which assumptions support your adjustment strategy?

chunks.en: only when its assumptions are appropriate

sentences.en: The model estimates an association conditional on the included covariates.
sentences.zh: 该模型估计的是给定所纳入协变量条件下的关联。
sentences.note: conditional on 表示以某些变量为条件；included 表示实际纳入模型的变量。
sentences.question: How would you describe the covariates in your model?

chunks.zh: 以所纳入的协变量为条件的

sentences.en: Outliers deserve investigation before we decide whether to exclude them.
sentences.zh: 在决定是否排除离群值之前，应先进行核查。
sentences.note: deserve investigation 表示值得核查；whether to exclude them 表示尚待作出的决定。
sentences.question: What evidence would justify excluding an unusual observation?

sentences.en: Missing data can change both precision and the risk of bias.
sentences.zh: 缺失数据可能同时改变精确程度和偏倚风险。
sentences.note: both A and B 将两个影响并列；can change 保留对缺失机制及分析方法的依赖。
sentences.question: What would you report about missing data?

sentences.en: The missingness mechanism matters when choosing how to handle incomplete records.
sentences.zh: 选择如何处理不完整记录时，缺失机制十分重要。
sentences.note: matters 表示具有实质影响；when choosing 引出作出决策的情境。
sentences.question: How could different missingness mechanisms affect your analysis?

sentences.en: Subgroup differences require a direct comparison, not separate significance labels.
sentences.zh: 判断亚组之间是否有差异，需要直接比较，不能只看各自的显著性标签。
sentences.note: require 表示所需证据；separate significance labels 指分别显著或不显著的判断。
sentences.question: How would you test whether effects differ between subgroups?

sentences.en: An interaction term allows an association to vary across conditions.
sentences.zh: 交互项允许关联随条件变化。
sentences.note: allow something to do 表示允许某种变化；交互项在模型中表达这种变化，是否有统计证据还需检验。
sentences.question: How would you explain an interaction to a collaborator?

sentences.en: A larger sample may improve precision without removing systematic bias.
sentences.zh: 更大的样本可能提高精确程度，但未必消除系统性偏倚。
sentences.note: may improve 表示可能改善；without removing 区分精确程度和系统性偏倚这两个问题。
sentences.question: Which problems cannot be solved by increasing sample size?

chunks.zh: 却没有消除系统性偏倚

sentences.en: Model assumptions should be checked against the observed data structure.
sentences.zh: 应结合实际观测到的数据结构检查模型假设。
sentences.note: should be checked 使用被动语态；against 表示以数据结构为对照来核查。
sentences.question: Which model assumption is most relevant to your data?

chunks.zh: 对照观测到的数据结构

sentences.en: Exploratory findings can guide questions for a future confirmatory study.
sentences.zh: 探索性发现可以为未来的验证性研究提供问题线索。
sentences.note: guide questions for 表示引导后续研究问题；exploratory 和 confirmatory 区分研究目的。
sentences.question: Which exploratory finding would you prioritize for confirmation?

sentences.en: I report the estimated direction alongside its uncertainty interval.
sentences.zh: 我会同时报告估计效应的方向及其不确定性区间。
sentences.note: alongside 表示同时呈现；estimated direction 提醒方向来自估计，需结合区间理解。
sentences.question: How would you summarize an estimate with substantial uncertainty?

sentences.en: The conclusion should reflect the strength and scope of the evidence.
sentences.zh: 结论应与证据的强度及适用范围相一致。
sentences.note: the strength and scope of 并列说明证据的两个维度；should reflect 用于提出表述原则。
sentences.question: Which word would you change to make a conclusion more accurate?
